Mireille Fontaine — Backend / Platform Engineering

Staff Backend Engineer, Anchorwell Payments (Jul 2023 - Present)
- Own the settlement reconciliation service end to end, closing each business day's payment batches across three currencies.
- Rebuilt the reconciliation pipeline from scratch following a 2023 data-loss incident during a database migration; every batch since has processed without a repeat incident.
- Led the migration of the payments ledger from a self-hosted Postgres cluster to a managed, multi-region database service.
- Introduced a canary deployment process for the payments API, giving the team a safer path to production for a payment-critical service.
- Participate in the org-wide incident response rotation for payment-critical services, working across team boundaries during live production incidents.
- Built the fraud-signal ingestion path feeding the risk team's models, coordinating directly with that team on their requirements.

Senior Backend Engineer, Anchorwell Payments (Feb 2021 - Jul 2023)
- Built the idempotency-key service adopted by the checkout team to prevent duplicate charges.
- Re-architected the payment authorization path, reducing peak-hour checkout latency.
- Served as on-call primary for the payments service for six consecutive quarters.
- Wrote the internal runbook for PCI-DSS scope reduction, subsequently adopted by the security team as their reference — engineering work rather than formal compliance auditing.
- Informally mentored two mid-level engineers joining the payments team (no formal reporting line or hiring authority).

Backend Engineer, Harborline Payments (Mar 2018 - Feb 2021)
- Migrated batch settlement jobs from cron scripts to an Airflow-based pipeline.
- Implemented retry and backoff logic for failed card-network calls.
- Investigated and fixed a currency-conversion rounding error that had gone undetected for several months.
- Built the merchant onboarding API in partnership with the platform team.
- Contributed test coverage for the refund processing service.
- Presented the settlement pipeline redesign at the company's internal quarterly engineering demo.

Software Engineer, Voss Analytics (Aug 2015 - Feb 2018)
- Built nightly ETL jobs loading client usage data into a reporting warehouse.
- Wrote the first version of the internal API behind the analytics dashboard.
- Set up the team's first CI pipeline using Jenkins.
- Performance-tuned slow SQL reports used by the customer success team.
- Provided on-call coverage for the reporting service during quarterly close.

Junior Developer, Kestrel Digital (Jul 2014 - Jul 2015)
- Built internal Python tooling for the operations team and documented the internal deployment process.

Profile note
- Ten years hands-on as a backend engineer, progressing from Junior Developer to Staff Engineer; roughly eight of those years in payments, a regulated domain. Technical leadership to date has been through service ownership, migrations, deployment tooling and informal mentoring rather than a formal management line — this application is for a first move into people management, and the corpus behind it contains no prior direct reports, hiring, performance reviews or budget ownership.
- Production experience in Go, Python and Java.

job.raw_text:
Engineering Manager, Platform Team
Nimbus Cloudworks - Hybrid (Berlin) or Remote (EU)

Who we are

Nimbus Cloudworks makes the internal developer platform that other companies build
their own platforms on top of. Our Platform team is the backbone of the engineering
org: deployment tooling, on-call standards, and the infrastructure everyone else
depends on to ship.

The role

We're hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our Platform team through its next phase
of growth. You'll manage a small group of backend engineers, own the team's roadmap
and budget, and be the person who represents platform concerns when the rest of the
company is planning. We want someone who has been a hands-on engineer before and
still remembers what that's like.

What you'll own

- Directly managing a team of software engineers: hiring, growth, and performance
- The team's budget for cloud infrastructure spend
- Running incident response and postmortems when platform services go down
- Representing the team in quarterly cross-org planning
- Setting the team's technical roadmap in partnership with senior engineers

What we're looking for

- 3+ years directly managing a team of software engineers, including hiring and
  performance reviews
- Experience owning a team budget, not just contributing estimates to one
- A background as a hands-on software engineer before moving into management
- Experience running incident response and postmortems for production outages
- Comfortable representing the team in cross-org planning conversations
- Genuinely good at giving feedback that people can act on

Nice to have

- Experience in a regulated industry such as payments or healthcare
- Familiarity with Kubernetes or a comparable orchestration platform
- Experience scaling a team from a handful of engineers to a larger one
- Public speaking or conference experience
- Experience setting a company-wide technical strategy, not just a team one

What we offer

Competitive compensation, a relocation package if you need one, generous parental
leave, and a team that has been through an incident or two together. Nimbus
Cloudworks is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.
